requirements.statement: Every required gate is bound to one source SHA and one integration base SHA.
Evidence validates exact lane Git objects, actual compiler/target, one workflow run/attempt and all required step outcomes; parsing does not authenticate remote execution.
A crash at each durable execution boundary never creates a second physical model effect.
Unknown provider outcome is never converted to NotStarted without durable provider evidence.
Stale generations cannot commit after lifecycle handoff.
Durable control state and in-memory active generation converge deterministically or fail closed.
Administrative truth queries are distinct from current-use guarded result access.
HOL evidence is collected before any lock topology change.
The ordinary Agentd lifecycle owns V2 startup, explicit stopped restart, quiesce and shutdown without opening a gate before reconciliation.
The joint admission/provider rollback gap remains explicit and target-host product evidence rejects an open disposition.
Target-host product evidence binds one candidate, real authenticated artifacts, every durable cut and the complete fault matrix without authorizing activation or release.

A future V3 segment manifest cannot reinterpret V2 bytes and must preserve success, failure, reservation, dispatch, receipt, checkpoint, witness and historical-query meaning across every migration crash cut.
